design: First pass uses donor input and restores receiver attention/MLP output at both value positions, one layer0–4site at a time. Measure surviving L5H5 local-value difference relative to receiver. Fresh receiver second pass reads only that surviving difference with native receiver routing. Same target/zero controls, task/nuisance/identity and lexical cohorts as H781. Compare target-minus-surviving margin effects with prior donor-swap sufficiency.
limitations: Path-specific restoration, not whole-model task necessity. Residual embeddings/x0/other paths remain donor in first pass. Nonlinear upstream and downstream effects can make supplied and removed effects differ; no unique causal fractions.
